subject: MagPay inference budget tightening — pilot options & next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@magpay.com>, Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@magpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MagPay inference budget tightening — pilot options & next steps

Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet the MagPay fraud team. Quick recap so we all have the same frame and the options we discussed for a low-risk pilot that focuses on cost and latency.

High-level pain points you shared
- Peak-hour latency spikes affecting checkout flow (p95 observed ~450ms under load; SLA target is 200ms).
- Token-driven cost is the primary blocker for expanding real-time scoring (current vendor ~ $0.005 per call on average).
- Budget runway is tight this quarter; procurement is asking for a clear ROI before committing to a larger rollout.

Goals we agreed on
- Prove we can reduce per-call cost to <= $0.0025 while keeping p95 latency < 250ms for scoring path.
- Validate batching/caching levers with production-like traffic to show a 30–45% token reduction on typical sessions.
- Deliver a clear cost/ops playbook for the fraud use case that procurement can sign off on.

What Redwood proposes (pilot options)
- Baseline & optimize (recommended): 6-week engagement (2wk baseline + 4wk optimization).
  - Baseline run to collect token distribution and latency under your traffic (no infra changes).
  - Optimization: prefix KV caching for repeat-session checks, selective batching for low-latency micro-batches, and a quantized 4-bit model variant for non-sensitive backfill.
  - Expected impact (based on similar customers): 30–45% token reduction, 15–30% latency improvement p95 depending on traffic patterns; estimated unit cost drop from $0.005 -> ~$0.0028–0.0029 on hosted configs; dedicated capacity can push lower.
- Compressed pilot (you asked about faster timelines): 4-week compressed scope (collect + 2 weeks optimization). Lower visibility but faster turnaround; requires prioritizing caching rules and a narrow traffic slice.

Deliverables and success metrics
- KPI dashboard: p50/p95 latency, cost per call, tokens per call, error rate.
- Concrete runbook: caching rules, batching thresholds, and config for production rollout.
- Recommendation: go/no-go decision for Dedicated capacity with order-of-magnitude cost projection.

Asks from MagPay to get started
1) Share a small sample of anonymized request/response logs (first-party only) and token-size distribution for the scoring endpoint.
2) Approval to run a short A/B on a 5% traffic slice for the optimization window.
3) SOC2 + security questionnaire contact (we can share our SOC2 report + network diagrams once procurement requests them).

Budget sense & options
- We can structure the pilot with a spend cap. Typical baseline/optimization pilots of this scope land in the $12–18k range on hosted with monitoring and engineering time included.
- If MagPay wants a 4-week pilot, we can compress to ~$9–10k with a tighter scope or provide a partial credit if you move to Dedicated within 90 days.

Attachments: magpay-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAV with milestones), redwood-pilot-scope.pdf (detailed technical scope). I dropped a HubSpot record and a DocuSign SOW link below for your convenience.

Proposed near-term next steps
- Alex / Priya: confirm preferred pilot cadence (6-week recommended vs 4-week compressed) and whether the $12–18k range works or you need a firm cap.
- If you approve, we’ll send a short SOW and a data transfer checklist to start baseline collection.

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick 20-min sync to finalize scope.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Kimberly — thanks for the write-up and the level set. Two quick clarifications from our side: we are under a pretty tight procurement cap this quarter (budget owners set a hard $10k pilot ceiling unless we can show a firm path to cost neutrality inside 30 days).

A few asks from our procurement/security folks before we can spin up anything:
- SOC2 report and a short summary of where data is persisted and for how long (we can redact specifics but need the compliance artifacts).
- Can the compressed 4-week pilot land at $10k if we scope it to a single production-like endpoint and limit traffic to ~3%?
- Also want to confirm you won't require us to move traffic to Dedicated during pilot — we prefer hosted to minimize infra ops for now.

If you can confirm SOC2 + a $10k compressed pilot scope, I can push this through our procurement stack this week.

Alex
Alex Morgan
VP of Fraud Ops, MagPay

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround. We can absolutely accommodate the asks and adjust scope:

What we can do now (finalized compressed pilot option)
- 4-week compressed pilot capped at $10k (hosted, no Dedicated required during pilot).
- Scope: single scoring endpoint, 3% traffic slice, baseline collection week + 2 weeks optimization (we’ll focus on caching rules and micro-batching thresholds).
- Deliverables: KPI dashboard + short ops playbook. If we hit the agreed cost target (<= $0.0025 per call) in the optimization window we’ll issue a $3k pilot credit toward a Dedicated conversion within 90 days.

Security & procurement artifacts
- SOC2 and security summary: we’ll share the SOC2 report + short data flow diagram under an NDA. Ben will attach the questionnaire answers you can pass to procurement.

Next steps
1) I’ll send a short SOW (DocuSign link) and the mutual action plan to keep timelines tight.
2) Please share the anonymized logs and confirm the 3% traffic slice and a procurement contact.
3) Ben / Marissa and I will stand up a 20-min kickoff once SOW is signed.

Ben — can you prepare the questionnaire pack and the SOC2 export for Alex's procurement lead?

Thanks — we’ll get this moving as soon as the SOW is accepted.
